name: Ripple Tank
description: Psychedelic 3-pass wave-interference tank — click to drop rings, hold to drive an oscillator, bass pumps the sources while caustic sparkles chase the wavefronts.

params.name: Wave Speed
params.description: Propagation speed c of the discrete wave equation (0.08–0.45 world units)

params.name: Damping
params.description: Velocity retention per step (0.975–0.9995) — high values ring for seconds

params.name: Source Strength
params.description: Amplitude and frequency of mouse driver, click ripples, and audio rain

params.name: Boundary Reflect
params.description: Edge behavior: 0 = absorbing shore, 1 = fully reflecting tank walls
